lines.text: Democrats won both the House and the Senate on Tuesday. Here's how X took it.
In Texas, Democrat James Talarico beat Ken Paxton for the Senate: the party's first statewide win there in 32 years.
Many posts parodied the warnings about what a Democratic win would bring.
House Democrats posted, “Let's get to work.” The replies came fast.
The new Congress takes over in January.
What did your feed look like?
